title: SimplifAI
tagline: SimplifAI: Making Crypto Easier for Me, for You. Our AI assistant simplifies crypto with voice commands & an AI portfolio manager. Features: Voice Commands, Real-Time AI Analysis, AI Portfolio Manager, Trusted Execution, Real-Time Notifications.
description:
*SimplifAI*

Web3 experiences is tricky and challenging for everyone, where even to make a transaction users might find themselves confused. These obstacles are slowing down crypto adoption! We are here to harness the power of AI and Blockchain to design a targeted solution to increase crypto adoption.

Here is how we solve it!

Introducing SimplifAI:
"Crypto Easier for Me, for You"

An AI powered Assistant dedicated to simplifying crypto for every users, through Voice Commands & AI-Powered Portfolio Manager.

We help users to seamless perform transactions and manage their portfolio in crypto easily using AI Agents.

Every Complex Transactions can now be sumarized through 3 easy steps:
1. Connect Your Wallet
2. Make transactions through simple voice command
3. Confirm your transaction and Sign it

Just connect your wallet with us, and start Speaking. We will handle the rest.

How We Implement It
1. Voice Command Actions
Using Speech-To-Text and LLM Models, our AI Agents will process voice messages from users and prepare the transaction. From transfering, swapping, even managing your portfolio, it's possible!

2. Real-Time AI-Analysis
Utilizing Hermes Web Service from Pyth, our AI Model analyze the market in real-time to provide recommendations for users, enabling users to obtain key market insights and trends.

3. AI-Controlled & Customizable Portfolio Manager
Utilizing Circle Web3 Services and OneInch API, users can customize their own AI to handle their portfolio autonomously. Users can effortless manage their crypto without looking at thousands of charts and statistics.

4. Trusted Execution Environment
An AI Agent requires more than just its performance, but also needs a verifiable system to ensure the integrity of it's code. We deployed our project on TEE using Phala Network to protect our AI Agent's capabilities. You can be assured that no parties are able to tamper with our source code.

We don't want to be the next future rugpullers!
We don't want our users to lose their money to mistakes!
Thus it's important to run these AI models in a secure, tamper-free environment.

5. Real-Time Notifications
Every single autonomous action will be securely recorded and notified to users in real-time through Push Protocol. We make sure that you know what your AI is doing, giving you the peace of mind.

With SimplifAI, we make crypto easy and more user-friendly for everyone. If you can use a TV remote, you can send and receive crypto with our help!


Crypto for all, all for Crypto.
how_its_made:
This project uses OpenAI's 4o model with Google Chrome inbuilt Speech-To-Text model to handle the voice commands from user. To feed the trading algorithm AI with current market price points of "ETH/USD" pair, we used Hermes Web Service from Pyth Network, allowing us to monitor the price real-time. 

For Portfolio Manager, we used Circle Developer Wallet, and 1inch to enable automated swapping of token without needing users to be present, allowing us to get tokens at the perfect price. To ensure safety of users data and funds, all source code will be running in Phala Network's TEE, a tamper-proof environment.

Last but not least, to allow users to receive real-time notifications, we utilize Push Protocol, ensuring users never miss out of anything, anywhere, anytime.
